input: I have high blood pressure and take amlodipine every day.
Type 2 diabetes for six years, on metformin. Also high cholesterol, on atorvastatin.
Asthma; I use a salbutamol inhaler a few times a month.
I broke my arm in 2019 and it healed completely. Nothing else.
Migraines about twice a month; I take sumatriptan when they start.
Atrial fibrillation, on apixaban. I also have hypertension.
Psoriasis on both elbows; I use a steroid cream.
COPD diagnosed last year. Ex-smoker. I use a tiotropium inhaler daily.
Epilepsy. Seizure-free for three years on levetiracetam, which I still take.
Acid reflux (GERD); I take omeprazole daily.
أعاني من ارتفاع ضغط الدم ومرض السكري من النوع الثاني وأتناول الأدوية بانتظام.
I had gestational diabetes in 2021; it resolved after my baby was born and my sugar tests have been normal since. No other conditions.
